body.text: This is fighting for upper body or legs.

items: The upper body player wins with an underhook on the lower body player, or by pushing his hands to the mat.
The lower body player wins with a touch behind the upper body player's leg, or by pushing his hands to the mat.

body.text: This is knocking him down from sitting.

items: The bottom player wins by standing up to grab the top player's hips, or by putting the top player's back on the mat and standing.
The top player wins by touching his shin to the bottom player's knees or body.

body.text: This is holding his back from behind.

items: The attacker holds while his chest stays on the defender's back.
The defender wins by getting his back to the mat or turning face to face.
